Updated the Treasury Bulletin capital-movements skill and compact memory.

Generalizable lesson saved:
- For U.S. liquidity ratio / U.S. to Foreigners prompts:
  - ratio = marketable liabilities / liabilities to foreign official institutions * 100
  - absolute change is in percentage points
  - OfficeQA may still expect a trailing percent sign, e.g. 9.89%, even when prose says “absolute percentage points”
  - historical-event clues should be resolved to the calendar year first, then mapped to the Treasury row/column.
